messages.subject: Documenting Methods with Class
parts:
I have a S4 class that I have defined, generic foo, method foo. The class, generic, and method are documented with Roxygen2.  The generic foo and method foo are getters for the class.  I am using the #'@describeIn foo to try to document the methods with the class but I am not having any luck.

Here is the method before the describe in

 #' Method to extract SpotSpread from S4 class
  #' @param object The name of the S4 object of type MortgageTermStructure
  #' @exportMethod SpotSpread
  setMethod("SpotSpread", signature("MortgageTermStructure"),
            function(object){object@SpotSpread})


Here is the method after using describeIn

  #' Method to extract SpotSpread from S4 class
  #' @describeIn MortgageTermStructure-class
  #' @param object The name of the S4 object of type MortgageTermStructure
  #' @exportMethod SpotSpread
  setMethod("SpotSpread", signature("MortgageTermStructure"),
            function(object){object@SpotSpread})
 
I thought, based on the book R Packages the method would be documented with the class but that is not happening.  So I am doing something wrong but I can't quite figure it out.

Has anyone tried this?
